notes.title: UI Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] UI default state set to active
[*] Removed double jump glitch
[*] Added collision to some ghost objects
[*] Fixed save data system bug for new players
[/list]
Now new players will have defaulted UI visability settings to true. Concurrent players that have this issue will have to turn this settings manually to true in settings.
